integrity: Complete derivation and standalone exact-rational checker are included; finite tests corroborate, rather than prove, the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Finite loopless directed graphs, nonnegative arc weights, minimum external incoming operator with zero for an empty set, and 0<=lambda<=1 only; no facet or vertex enumeration; historical-priority risk beyond targeted searches.
title: Sharp half-weight transition and core dimension in parametric directed trust games
